entities.summary: Christopher Robin Felix is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman. He played junior for the Sault Ste. Marie Greyhounds and was the team's captain in the 1984–85 season. He played for 35 games in the National Hockey League with the Washington Capitals from 1988 to 1990, who signed him as a free agent in 1988. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1985 to 2002, was spent in the minor leagues and in European leagues. Internationally Felix played for the Canadian national team at the 1988 Winter Olympics.
